marcelo.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for an existing 2D arcade fighting game. Reference image: the attached atlas is the exact character identity and established painted arcade illustration style. Create a NEW sibling movement-and-dizzy atlas of THE SAME ONE MAN, preserving his facial identity, hair, clothes, proportions, colors and detailed line/shading style. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow, no labels, no effects, no objects, no extra fingers. Exactly 16 complete full-body poses in a precise 4 columns x 4 rows grid, row-major. Every pose faces RIGHT in side-three-quarter view, every head and every foot visible with generous transparent cell margins; poses must not cross cell boundaries. Same body scale in ALL cells, same foot baseline per row, coherent anatomically correct hands, feet and knees. No stretched limbs. Four hundred pixels of character height is fine in a square 2048 atlas.
Cells 0-7 (top two rows): one coherent EIGHT-FRAME fighting-footwork step cycle. Carefully show weight transferring from support foot to advancing foot and then rear foot catching up, not two legs frozen in a wide stance. Maintain ready guard, no hands swinging like civilian walking. No crossed legs. Distinguish the eight phases with actual bent-knee/heel/hip movement, all feet grounded except the moving foot slightly lifted.
Cells 8 and 9 (third row first two): two consecutive forward burst-step poses, coiled launch then quick driving step. Cells 10 and 11 (third row last two): two consecutive backward evasive-step poses, rear-foot push then front foot following, chest leaning backward while keeping eye on opponent RIGHT.
Cells 12-15 (bottom row): four consecutive DIZZY/STUNNED poses. Clearly slack guard, knees buckling but still STANDING, dazed face and half-closed eyes, arms loosely hanging/open, torso rocking left then right, head drooping then swaying, losing balance. Not sitting or kneeling. Do NOT draw stars; game draws them. Preserve body and facial identity. Each cell isolated.
Character and specific movement: A sturdy bearded dark-haired man in an olive green polo, dark blue jeans and black trainers. His Krav Maga footwork is low, planted and direct: compact bent-knee steps with a protective OPEN front palm and rear fist near jaw, wide stable weight transfer, minimal bounce. Forward burst is a decisive low entry with open-palmed guard, backward step a short defensive withdrawal. It must look different from a boxer.
